propositions: When close-gate completion verification fails with insufficiency due to search exhaustion without criterion refutation, the gate should automatically re-run verification instead of surfacing failure to the operator
Auto-resume qualification must reuse the existing _insufficiency_only predicate unchanged, requiring no schema or prompt modifications
Resumption attempts are bounded by verify.auto_resume_max config (default 2; 0 disables) and gated by strict progress—resuming only when prior attempt increased cache-credited PASS count
Each auto-resume attempt and its outcomes (attempt number, cache-credited count, remaining unmet) must be recorded in the verdict trail and visible to the operator
The resumption loop must sit at the shared close-gate seam (close_precheck._completion_precheck's verify_completion call) so CLI, MCP, and library close paths all exercise it
